messages:
sara_support: FYI a customer (HelixCo) just escalated — their org admin can't invite new members, getting 403 on the console and API. They say this started right after their IdP team trimmed delegated scopes yesterday.

ida_sre: can you paste the exact API response / screenshot? any errors in console logs?

sara_support: pasted the curl response from their SRE (redacted):
```
$ curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/orgs/helix/invite' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ey...'
{"error":"permission_denied","message":"insufficient_scope: missing scope org:members:write","status":403}
```

alex_idp: that "insufficient_scope" string is coming from our token introspection path. Sounds like their delegated token no longer contains org:members:write. Did they rotate the client or change consent?

monica_eng: did they use delegated admin tokens or the console flow? if console, the browser flow exchanges an ephemeral token with scopes from the OIDC idp.

sara_support: they reported an IdP change — DevOps removed some delegated scopes to tighten privileges. They expected console to fall back to service token for invites but it doesn't. Invite button is greyed out in UI.

ida_sre: repro checklist: 1) sign in as org-admin via IdP 2) attempt invite 3) watch network tab for /v1/orgs/:org/invite 4) check token introspection at /auth/introspect -> scope list.

monica_eng: quick workaround: temporarily restore the delegated scope org:members:write on the IdP client or grant the org-admin an API key with that scope. Longer term we need a clearer UX note.

alex_idp: internal note: IdP teams sometimes remove granular scopes and rely on a fallback service token which our console does not request for interactive flows. We'll file an action to make the console request an additional service-scope exchange when delegated scopes don't include required perms.

ida_sre: for the support ticket, share repro steps and ask customer to: 1) confirm the id_token/access_token scopes in devtools; 2) try re-adding org:members:write and confirm invite works; 3) if they can't change IdP config, we can create a scoped service API key as temporary fix.

sara_support: i've informed the customer and created a short runbook for them. Attaching inline snippet I sent: 
```
# check scopes in browser console
const token = localStorage.getItem('redwood_ephemeral_token')
// paste to https://jwt.io or call introspection
curl -X POST https://auth.redwood.example/introspect -d \"token=${token}\"
```
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-17T14:12 UTC: no code changes.

monica_eng: follow-up action: eng to add a telemetry alert for failed invite attempts with reason insufficient_scope so support can triage faster. I'll open a GH issue.

ida_sre: marking as resolved-for-now with workaround; will escalate to eng if more customers hit this after IdP hardening. :white_check_mark:
